hero.title: About Logicraft Studio
hero.subtitle: A free, open-source embedded systems and SPICE circuit simulator — built by me, Chirudeep Reddy, ECE Student at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bengaluru.

story.heading: My Story & Motivation
story.p1: I am Chirudeep Reddy (Roll No: BL.EN.U4ECE24164), an Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) student at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham (Amrita University), Bengaluru.
story.p2: As an ECE student working on microcontrollers and circuit design, I experienced firsthand how difficult it can be to access physical hardware, test components late at night, or debug complex breadboard circuits with damaged ICs and loose wiring.
story.p3: Driven by my passion for hardware engineering, microcontrollers, and software development, I set out to build a tool that bridges the gap between electronics education and browser technology — allowing students and makers to simulate Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, and SPICE circuits without needing physical hardware upfront.
story.p4: I built Logicraft Studio to combine real CPU emulation (AVR8, Xtensa, RISC-V, ARM) with real-time SPICE analog circuit analysis and live test instruments, giving students a zero-friction playground to write firmware, wire components, and analyze signals instantly.
story.p5: Today, I have made Logicraft Studio 100% open-source (AGPLv3) and freely available to students, educators, and embedded enthusiasts around the world.

howItWorks.heading: How It Works
howItWorks.avrRp2040Body: Cycle-accurate emulation runs entirely in your browser using avr8js and rp2040js. No backend needed for simulation.
howItWorks.esp32Body: Xtensa ESP32 and ESP32-S3 run on backend QEMU (lcgamboa fork) with real flash images, GPIO, ADC, and timers.
howItWorks.riscvBody: ESP32-C3 (DevKit, XIAO, SuperMini) and CH32V003 are emulated through the QEMU lcgamboa fork with libqemu-riscv32, the same backend pattern as Xtensa ESP32.
howItWorks.raspiBody: Full ARM Cortex-A53 Linux via QEMU raspi3b — boots real Raspberry Pi OS and runs Python with RPi.GPIO.

openSource.heading: Open Source Philosophy
openSource.lead: Logicraft Studio is 100% open source under the AGPLv3 license. No cloud dependency, no student accounts, no data leaving your network. Universities and bootcamps can deploy it on their own servers with a single Docker command and give every student access to a complete embedded development environment — for free.
openSource.creditsIntro: The project builds on top of amazing open-source work from the community:

credits.qemuLcgamboa: ESP32 and Raspberry Pi QEMU emulation

openSource.inspiredBy: Logicraft Studio was inspired by Wokwi, which is a fantastic tool. My goal with Logicraft Studio is to take a different path: fully open source, self-hostable, and supporting multiple heterogeneous boards in the same circuit.

creator.heading: About Me
creator.role: ECE Student @ Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bengaluru
creator.bio1: I am Chirudeep Reddy (Roll No: BL.EN.U4ECE24164), an undergraduate student in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bengaluru.
creator.bio2: I am passionate about embedded systems, VLSI, microcontrollers, signal processing, and full-stack software development. I love building developer tools that make electronics education accessible to everyone.
creator.bio3: I designed and built Logicraft Studio — an open-source multi-board embedded systems and SPICE circuit simulator for students, makers, and engineers.

releases.heading: Recent releases
releases.v3Tagline: Retro CPUs, multi-board systems, full-circuit accuracy
releases.v3Blurb: Programmable Z80/8080/4004 retro CPUs with custom ROM, MicroSD and ePaper emulation, true multi-board UART/I2C/SPI interconnect, ESP32-CAM, full undo/redo, the complete ngspice WASM migration, an 88% smaller bundle, and 100+ new examples.
releases.v25Tagline: Arduino meets SPICE in your browser
releases.v25Blurb: Real-time analog circuit simulation via ngspice-WASM, wired to Arduino, ESP32 and Raspberry Pi Pico. 100+ SPICE-accurate components, live ammeters and voltmeters, 40 new analog/hybrid examples — co-simulated with your firmware.
releases.v2Blurb: Full QEMU-driven ESP32 emulation with WiFi/BLE, Raspberry Pi 3B Linux, MicroPython support across Pico/ESP32, custom WASM chips, and a redesigned canvas with multi-board co-simulation.

quote.p1: "As an ECE student, I realized that our best ideas shouldn't be blocked by missing hardware or damaged laboratory components."
quote.p2: "I built Logicraft Studio to give every student a complete, SPICE-accurate electronics lab directly in their browser tab."
